description: boids is a Pure Data external library that provides 2D and 3D flocking simulation objects ([boids2d] and [boids3d]) based on Craig Reynolds' flocking algorithm. It simulates the collective flight and herding dynamics of birds and other animals for algorithmic composition, visual animation, and spatialization.

research.notes: Originally created by Eric L. Singer for Max and adapted for Pure Data by André Sier and jasch (with pd-lib-builder support maintained in pd-externals), the library includes [boids2d] and [boids3d] objects. It is also packaged for Debian/Ubuntu under the source package pd-boids (https://salsa.debian.org/multimedia-team/pd/pd-boids) and available on puredata.info (https://puredata.info/downloads/boids).
